definitions.explanation: Relating to the physical body as opposed to the mind or spirit.

examples.japanese: {肉体的|にくたいてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{疲|つか}れている→疲れる：00901_tsukareru⟧。
⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{肉体的|にくたいてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦きつい→きつい：02342_kitsui⟧。
{肉体的|にくたいてき}な⟦{苦痛|くつう}→苦痛：02652_kutsuu⟧⟦だけ→〜だけ：03093_dake⟧で⟦なく→ない：01118_nai⟧、⟦{精神的|せいしんてき}→精神的：05851_seishinteki⟧な⟦{苦痛|くつう}→苦痛：02652_kutsuu⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: There's not only physical pain but also mental pain.

notes:
USAGE: {肉体的|にくたいてき} specifically refers to the physical body, often contrasted with ⟦{精神的|せいしんてき}→精神的：05851_seishinteki⟧ (mental/spiritual).

FORMS:
- {肉体的|にくたいてき}な＋noun (bodily/physical ~)
- {肉体的|にくたいてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧ (physically - adverbial form)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {肉体的|にくたいてき}な⟦{疲労|ひろう}→疲労：13603_hirou⟧ (physical fatigue)
- {肉体的|にくたいてき}な⟦{苦痛|くつう}→苦痛：02652_kutsuu⟧ (physical pain)
- {肉体的|にくたいてき}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦きつい→きつい：02342_kitsui⟧ (physically demanding)
- {肉体的|にくたいてき}⟦{労働|ろうどう}→労働：03785_roudou⟧ (physical labor)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{物理的|ぶつりてき}→物理的：06197_butsuriteki⟧ - physical (relating to physics/material world)
- {肉体的|にくたいてき} - physical (relating specifically to the body)
- ⟦{身体的|しんたいてき}→身体的：05852_shintaiteki⟧ - physical, bodily (similar to {肉体的|にくたいてき}, often used in medical/formal contexts)
